Install from [get.newtalaria.com/cli](https://get.newtalaria.com/cli), then run `talaria version`. This page is generated from the CLI command tree (pinned in `docs.lock.yaml`). See [CLI](/cli/) for install and everyday workflow.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `talaria` | Install OpenTelemetry into a Talaria project |
| `talaria agent` | Set up Talaria for a coding agent |
| `talaria agent setup` | Install MCP config, skills, and the AGENTS.md block |
| `talaria collector` | Generate and apply the OpenTelemetry Collector config |
| `talaria collector apply` | Write the plan and apply it. CI defaults to plan-only unless TALARIA_APPLY=1 or --yes. |
| `talaria collector init` | Detect the stack and write a reviewable talaria.yaml |
| `talaria collector inspect` | Show detected stack, registry matches, and current talaria.yaml |
| `talaria collector plan` | Print a unified diff of official Collector/Helm/Compose/systemd artifacts (writes nothing) |
| `talaria collector uninstall` | Stop the local Collector. Does not delete server projects or keys. |
| `talaria collector upgrade` | Print how to move the Collector pin. Does not replace the binary via OpAMP. |
| `talaria collector validate [file]` | Validate talaria.yaml against the published JSON Schema |
| `talaria detect [path]` | Detect the setup from registry rules. Source stays on this machine. |
| `talaria docs` | Search and print Talaria docs (the same pages as MCP) |
| `talaria docs get <path>` | Print one docs page (MCP get_doc) |
| `talaria docs search <query>` | Search Talaria docs (MCP search_docs) |
| `talaria doctor [path]` | Static setup checks. --fix only edits .gitignore and an env key name |
| `talaria init [path]` | Install the Talaria SDK for an official app stack |
| `talaria issue` | Read a Talaria issue |
| `talaria issue brief <id>` | Print the agentBrief for an issue (UUID or short ref) |
| `talaria keys` | Mint project keys via apiKey.create (same use case as MCP) |
| `talaria keys create` | Create a key. --collector is --preset collector (secret). Prints the secret once on a TTY. --json never prints it. |
| `talaria login` | Sign in from a browser. The CLI never asks for a code or password. |
| `talaria logout` | Delete the stored session |
| `talaria mcp` | Install, call, or serve the Talaria MCP |
| `talaria mcp call <tool>` | Call one MCP tool with the CLI login |
| `talaria mcp install` | Write MCP client config, skills, and the AGENTS.md block |
| `talaria mcp list` | Show MCP config, skills, and the AGENTS.md block for each client |
| `talaria mcp remove` | Remove Talaria MCP config, skills, and the AGENTS.md block |
| `talaria mcp serve` | Serve the Talaria MCP over stdio using the CLI login |
| `talaria projects` | Create a project in the signed-in organization |
| `talaria projects create <name>` | Create a project. Prints the id and name, never a key. |
| `talaria releases` | Record a release, its commits, and a deploy |
| `talaria releases deploy` | POST /v1/deploys for one environment |
| `talaria releases finalize` | POST /v1/releases again with the commit list (no server finalized flag) |
| `talaria releases new` | POST /v1/releases with an empty commit list |
| `talaria sourcemaps` | Upload JavaScript source maps and Dart / Flutter debug symbols |
| `talaria sourcemaps upload [path]` | Upload *.js.map, Flutter web maps, Dart obfuscation maps, and .symbols files |
| `talaria status` | Show heartbeat and last ingest. Same words as the Install tab. |
| `talaria upgrade` | Record the CLI release channel. Does not download a binary. |
| `talaria verify [-- command]` | Probe ingest, or start the app and wait for the first event |
| `talaria version` | Print CLI and pinned Collector versions |
| `talaria whoami` | Print the signed-in account. Tokens are never printed. |
